results.title: Nigeria approves 15 billion naira for Safe Schools programme | UA.NEWS
results.snippet:
Nigeria’s federal government has approved 15 billion naira for the implementation of the Safe Schools programme in 2026. Halima Iliya, the national coordinator of the Safe Schools Financing Programme, stated this at the annual summit of the Association of Education Writers in Nigeria in Lagos, Premium Times reports.
